strings.name: Tony Hawk
strings.summary: Tony Hawk became a leading American vert skateboarder after turning professional as a teenager. His celebrated 900 at the 1999 X Games became a landmark spectacle. He co-founded Birdhouse and brought skating to a wider public through his video-game series. His nonprofit, The Skatepark Project, supports public skateparks; in 2026 he continued visiting community parks and skating.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through November 16, 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Technical breakthroughs and commercial media brought skateboarding international attention and supported public skate facilities.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.highlights.h1.title: The 900
strings.highlights.h1.text: Completed two and a half airborne rotations after repeated attempts at the 1999 X Games, creating an enduring image of skateboarding.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education and early training
strings.facts.f2.value: Started skating at nine in local parks, attended Torrey Pines High School and turned professional at fourteen.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Games and public skateparks
strings.highlights.h2.text: His video-game series expanded the audience, while the nonprofit founded in 2002 helps communities plan and build free public skateparks.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Charlotte skatepark visit
strings.timeline.t1.text: Skated at Renaissance Park and left a signed board, continuing his visits to community skateparks.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Fracture and recovery
strings.timeline.t2.text: Broke his femur, underwent surgery and rehabilitation and subsequently worked his way back to skating.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Founded a nonprofit
strings.timeline.t3.text: Established the Tony Hawk Foundation, later renamed The Skatepark Project, to support skateparks in underserved communities.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Video-game debut
strings.timeline.t4.text: The first Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater brought skating culture to a wider audience through its tricks, environments and music.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Landed the 900
strings.timeline.t5.text: Completed the celebrated 900 at an X Games skating session in attempts outside the timed competition.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Co-founded Birdhouse
strings.timeline.t6.text: Established the skateboard company with Per Welinder, developing a brand and supporting skaters during an industry downturn.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Turned professional
strings.timeline.t7.text: Entered the professional ranks at fourteen and developed his competitive standing in vert skating.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Started skating
strings.timeline.t8.text: Received a skateboard from his brother and began practicing in local parks, forming a lasting sporting interest.
